finding: 'Delay keeps growing by about five seconds every day' ignores Earth's orbital motion
evidence_checked: JPL Horizons (Earth-centred, queried 2026-11-24): +6.7 s/day on 2026-11-24, +3.1 s/day May 2026/2027, about −2 s/day Feb–Mar 2027, up to +11.7 s/day Sep 2027.
